description: Root upstream domain: ingests raw market data from Binance WebSocket feeds (bookTicker, aggTrade), aggregates into structured ticks, constructs OHLCV bars, and emits deterministic events (EVT:MARKET_TICK_RECEIVED, EVT:BAR_CLOSED, EVT:ANCHOR_UPDATED) for downstream consumption. Two data paths: multi-process (worker+proxy, production) and single-process (connector, legacy).

deprecated_events.reason: No active emitter; removed from production paths

ssot_notes.bar_construction: BarAggregator is the single SSOT bar constructor. All OHLCV bars are built here from ticks; no other domain constructs bars.
ssot_notes.tick_aggregation: WebSocketAggregator is the single tick aggregator. Raw WS messages (bookTicker, aggTrade) → structured tick dict.
ssot_notes.data_paths: Production uses multi-process path (MarketDataWorker → IPC Queue → MarketDataProxy). Legacy single-process path (MarketDataConnector) is config-gated via use_multiprocessing flag.
ssot_notes.freshness: No TTL enforcement within domain. tick_ttl_ms and bar_ttl_ms are consumed by downstream domains (FE, DM). Market data emits raw data without staleness gating.
ssot_notes.dead_code: market_ws_client.py deleted in LEGACY-PURGE-WAVE-1 (2026-03-15). set_feature_engineering() no-op removed from connector and proxy.
ssot_notes.registry_verbs: ANCHOR_UPDATED (active, owner), BAR_CLOSED (active, owner), MARKET_TICK_RECEIVED (active, owner), MARKET_TICK_FORWARDED (deprecated 2026-03-14)
